body.statement: Under consistency and conditional exchangeability, the causal mean satisfies \(\mathbb E[Y^{q_\delta}]=\Psi_\delta(P)=\mathbb E_P[\mu_0(X)+\tau(X)\min\{1,\delta e(X)\}]\); no strong-overlap condition is required because \(q_\delta(1\mid x)=0\) when \(e(x)=0\) and \(q_\delta(0\mid x)=0\) when \(e(x)=1\).
body.justification: This fixes the causal interpretation while keeping identification separate from the statistical regularity problem.
body.gap: Zhou and Opacic identify related interventional effects; this proposition specializes their support-preserving logic to the exact capped mean used below.
body.consumer: Analysts can interpret every regularity and posterior result as inference for a feasible capped probability-multiplication policy.
